value.title: Senza Freni con le senpai
value.synopsis: The cherry blossoms are blooming, and the girls decide to go flower watching. When they arrive at the park, Yuri notices they've brought a few friends with them.

value.title: Bowling A Columbine con le senpai
value.synopsis: Udonko begs Yuri and Kanae for help with her family's udon business. They agree to help make udon at the shop and are taught the ins and outs of udon by a very special teacher.

value.title: Il Cavaliere Oscuro con le senpai
value.synopsis: When Mika tears her ACL, Bobby asks the girls to take her place in his annual hero show. Yuri is unsure, but the other members enthusiastically agree to do it.

value.title: Come D’Incanto con le senpai
value.synopsis: Once upon a time, there was a girl named Cinderella who wanted nothing more than to attend the party at the castle. However, with 245 evil sisters intead of two, will she be able to attend the party and meet her prince?

value.title: Ti presento i miei con le senpai
value.synopsis: The girls decide to form a band to get more out of their youth. However, the discussion quickly reaches an unusually serious level with tons of realistic terminology thrown around.

value.title: Wimbledon con le senpai
value.synopsis: The team's annual "Practice Super Seriously Day" has arrived. While the girls do indeed practice something that resembles tennis, it's still a far cry from "serious practice."

value.title: Il Pianeta Delle Scimmie con le senpai
value.synopsis: Marimo runs into Udonko, who is on her way to look for an unidentified flying object that crashed into a nearby park. While searching for the UFO, they meet up with Tomarin and Tanaka-san, who points them in the direction of some peculiar "playground equipment."

value.title: 2001: Odissea Nello Spazio con le senpai
value.synopsis: Marimo and her friends are trapped on an alien planet when their spaceship breaks down. While searching for the rubber band they need to repair their ship's engine, they come across a strange domed structure. When they open the door, they find a shocking surprise waiting for them.
